patch_ladder.name: m32_singlelaunch_bpreshuffle_nodup_apack_k512
patch_ladder.deleted_cost_center: standalone A-pack launch + a_packed/a_scale temp law on public m32; residual raw-B address shaping by switching to live b_shuffle
patch_ladder.why_larger_than_noise: Hits two benchmark cases and deletes the common two-launch law while using the dormant live b_shuffle contract.
patch_ladder.major_risk: Needless per-call B temp, high VGPR pressure, or accidental per-CTA A duplication would erase the one-launch win.
fast_falsifiers: If the branch requires new per-call shuffle_weight/materialized B temp, kill it.
If self CUDA exceeds ~2.7 us, the single-launch thesis is probably gone.
